name.description:
Full class name of the test for non-aggregated testsuite documents.
Class name without the package for aggregated testsuites documents

timestamp.description: when the test was executed. Timezone may not be specified.

hostname.description: Host on which the tests were executed. 'localhost' should be used if the hostname cannot be determined.

time.description: The time in seconds that the suite took to run.

errorCount.description: The count of errors not reported as failures (e.g. exceptions happened during the test execution, etc.).

testCount.description: The total number of test cases in the suite

skippedCount.description: The number of tests skipped. Currently the same as disabled.

disabledCount.description: The number of tests disabled. Currently the same as skipped.

failureCount.description: The number of tests that failed (i.e. the test assertion is incorrect).

warningCount.description: The number of tests that failed to meet the warning threshold.

networkRequests.description: The network requests associated with this test suite.

testcase.description: Array of all tests within the suite.

batchId.description: Id of the TestRunner batch (if applicable) in which this test ran.

testRunnerKind.description: The kind of TestRunner ran this test suite.

testCategory.description: The category of the test suite.

error.description:
The {@link TestSuite} error, if there exists one, that occurred during the TestSuite execution not related
the test cases.
Not be confused with {@link TestSuiteResult.errorCount}, which refers to the count errors reported in testcases

title: Contains the results of executing a testsuite
name: TestSuiteResult
